Tracking & SEO

From tagmanager.google.com — top of your workspace once you create a container. This is the single ID that manages GA4, Search Console verification, and any other tag on your public map and 3D view, without editing any files.
In Search Console, choose the "HTML tag" verification method — it gives you a meta tag like <meta name="google-site-verification" content="THIS_PART">. Paste just that content value here, not the whole tag.
Paste any YouTube link (watch, youtu.be, or Shorts). On the public map, this plays in place of the logo 3 seconds after the page loads, then the logo returns once the video finishes. Leave blank to disable.

Project Pin

BasicsLogo, name, type and how the pin looks
Click to upload an image
(auto-resized before saving)
Shows on the map pin itself and at the top of this project's public popup card.
Pin #1 is the company pin — the public map opens on it. Numbers must be unique.
Project detailsShown on the public project card
Shown on the public card. For several phases, separate numbers with commas.
MediaVideo and brochure for the card
Paste this project's own YouTube link (watch, youtu.be, or Shorts). In the popup's "Project Brochure" section, the brochure image below shows first, then swaps to this video (muted, autoplaying) a few seconds after a visitor opens the popup. Leave blank to just show the brochure image with no video.
Click to upload a brochure image
(auto-resized before saving)
Shows in the "Project Brochure" section of the public popup card, below the project details. Leave blank to skip that section (unless a video link above is set, which will still show on its own).
×
Sets the shape of the brochure image/video box on the public card — enter it as a ratio (e.g. 16 × 9 for widescreen, 9 × 16 for a vertical/Shorts video, 1 × 1 for square) or as exact pixel dimensions (e.g. 400 × 300); either way the box scales to fit the card width. Leave both blank for the default widescreen (16:9).
Public cardChoose what visitors see
Choose which fields show on this project's public map card. Changes go live for every visitor as soon as you save — no page refresh needed on their end.
Add anything not covered above (e.g. RERA No., Amenities). Each custom field gets its own on/off switch, same as the standard ones.
Tip: leave emoji blank and upload a custom icon below instead — the icon always overrides the emoji.
Click to upload a custom icon
(overrides the emoji)
